title: Package glossary
description: A package's own terms, at glossary/<package>.json (Y-2, the scoping idea of CSS Modules): each term stays local to the package unless export is true, so an agent working in another package sees only exported terms. Two packages exporting one term with different meanings fail schema/check-brand.mjs. Version 0.x, unevaluated.

package.description: The package whose terms these are; the file is glossary/<package>.json

export.description: true: other packages see it too
